verse.verse_1: Lo! We revealed it on the Night of Predestination.
verse.verse_2: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Night of Power is!
verse.verse_3: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months.
verse.verse_4: The angels and the Spirit descend therein, by the permission of their Lord, with all decrees.
verse.verse_5: (The night is) Peace until the rising of the dawn.
